minutes.headline: Sewer Commission heard good news on billing, hiring and a paid-in-full fee; a member is resigning.
minutes.summary: The Sewer Commission, chaired by the vice chair in place of Mike Mackin, approved prior minutes and heard that the owner of 12 Kemell Street will pay a privilege fee in full. Staff reported progress on second-quarter demands and quarterly billing in MUNIS, two candidates for assistant to the business manager, and that member Eli Torres will resign. The meeting also covered the FY24 annual report, manhole repairs delayed by frost, and upcoming meeting dates.
